summary: Replacement freezer door latch clip with thickened flex section and fillet to resist cold cracking.
assumptions: overall length 45mm, width 20mm, base 4mm thick as assumed
two 4mm mounting holes on 30mm spacing reuse existing screws
hook 8mm tall with 4mm catch lip holds against gasket pressure

parts.name: Freezer Door Latch Clip
parts.purpose: screws to freezer door and snap-fits onto catch to hold door shut

print.orientation: flat on base plate, hook upright (+Z), lip on top
